description:
# PNX-Terra

Terra world generator plugin for PowerNukkitX.

## Usage

- Build: `./gradlew build` (jar at `build/libs/PNX-Terra-1.0.0.jar`)
- Drop the jar into the server's `plugins` folder
- Use `terra` as the generator name when creating a level
- Terra config is extracted to `./terra/config.yml` on first start

## Notes

- Requires PowerNukkitX with the plugin generator registry (Registries.GENERATOR)
- Loads at STARTUP so the generator is available before worlds load
